corners.label: T2

corners.line: keep left front on painted line

corners.label: T2

corners.label: T3

corners.line: Stay on the white line longer, avoid crossing the seam early

corners.exit: push towards the light on exit

corners.line: Turn a little bit earlier, straighter approach

corners.line: Shift approach to the wall for better exit.
